heading: Build and deploy
body:
By default, ty bundle writes dist/web. To check a release, use --target all. Then preview or package the single target that you plan to release.

Yon compiles each Kotlin, Rust, Dart, Go and Groovy handler once. The project keeps the result in `.tachyon/handlers`, and ty keeps a copy in `TAC_CACHE_DIR/runtime/handlers-v1`, so another project or a fresh checkout with the same handler, models and compiler reuses it instead of compiling again. `ty cache clean` removes these copies.
